about.origins.p1: Founded with a vision to standardize high-performance inputs, VARS Aquaculture has evolved from a local trial in Türkiye to a multi-national entity. We provide the critical link between resource-rich origins and high-demand markets across South Korea, the Middle East and Canada.

guideIncubation.parameters.items.salinit: Use natural seawater or synthetic sea salt. Low salinity prolongs hatching time.
guideIncubation.parameters.items.tempera: Maintain constant temperature. Temperatures below 25 °C drastically decrease hatch-out velocity.
guideIncubation.parameters.items.aeratio: Keep cysts in continuous suspension. Avoid dead zones where cysts settle.
guideIncubation.parameters.items.light.d: Light triggers the embryonic development mechanism during the first 2 hours of hydration.
guideIncubation.steps.items.step1.title: Disinfection & Pre-hydration
guideIncubation.steps.items.step1.desc: Pre-soak dry Artemia cysts in clean freshwater for 30 minutes at 20–25 °C before transferring to salt water.
guideIncubation.steps.items.step2.title: Conical Tank Incubation
guideIncubation.steps.items.step2.desc: Fill conical hatching vessel with 30 ppt saltwater. Add cysts at a maximum density of 2 grams per liter.
guideIncubation.steps.items.step3.title: Harvesting & Separation
guideIncubation.steps.items.step3.desc: Turn off aeration after 20–24 hours. Nauplii swim toward light at the bottom while empty shells float to top.
guideIncubation.steps.items.step4.title: Cold-Storage Enrichment
guideIncubation.steps.items.step4.desc: Rinse harvested nauplii thoroughly. Store in chilled seawater (4–6 °C) or enrich with Emerald Chlorella.
guideIncubation.hero.title: Artemia Cysts Hatching & Incubation Manual
guideIncubation.hero.description: A step-by-step scientific guide to achieving ≥ 85% hatch-out rates, maximum nauplii biomass, and clean separation for marine larvae.
guideDecap.comparison.rows.shell.standar: Present — hatch before feeding to very young fry
guideDecap.comparison.rows.energy.standa: Standard caloric density; some energy used during hatching
guideDecap.comparison.rows.energy.decap: Higher net caloric density (502 kcal/100g) — no hatching energy loss
guideDecap.comparison.rows.equipment.dec: No hatching setup required — feed directly from the can
guideDecap.comparison.rows.biosecurity.s: Unhatched shells should be separated from feed for very sensitive fry
guideDecap.comparison.rows.biosecurity.d: No shell present — no separation step needed
guideDecap.segments.items.hatcheries.des: Operations with established hatching infrastructure often use Standard Cysts as a cost-effective live feed. For very young or sensitive post-larvae (sea bass, sea bream, grouper, shrimp), many hatcheries switch to Decapsulated Artemia to skip the hatching step and reduce shell-handling labor.
guideDecap.segments.items.aquariums.desc: Decapsulated Artemia gives a ready-to-feed, high-energy option for delicate filter feeders, seahorses, and pipefish, while Standard Cysts suit exhibits where on-site hatching is already part of the routine.
guideDecap.segments.items.retail.title: Aquarium Shops & Wholesale Retailers
guideDecap.segments.items.retail.desc: Both formats are available in shelf-stable retail cans (500g / 1kg) — Standard Cysts for customers who hatch their own live feed, and Decapsulated Artemia for customers who want a direct-feed option.
guideDecap.segments.items.hobbyists.desc: Decapsulated Artemia is convenient for direct feeding into reef tanks and fry-rearing setups without a hatching station, while Standard Cysts suit hobbyists who prefer to hatch their own nauplii.
guideDecap.hero.title: Standard vs Decapsulated Artemia Cysts: Choosing the Right Form
guideDecap.hero.description: Compare shell-on Standard Artemia Cysts and shell-free Decapsulated Artemia to find the right fit for your hatching setup, feeding protocol, and customer segment.
guideDecap.intro.heading: Standard vs Decapsulated Artemia: What's the Difference?
guideDecap.intro.paragraph1: Artemia cysts naturally have a thick outer shell known as the chorion. Standard cysts are typically hatched before feeding, since very young fry and shrimp larvae have limited ability to digest the unhatched shell — many other species and older larvae tolerate it without issue.
guideDecap.intro.paragraph2: Decapsulation is a chemical hydration and oxidation process that removes the outer chorion while leaving the living embryo intact in a thin membrane. This gives a higher net caloric density per gram and lets the cysts be fed directly without a separate hatching step — while Standard Cysts remain a cost-effective, widely used option for operations with established hatching infrastructure.

product.vital-wheat-gluten.longDescripti: At VARS Aquaculture, our wheat gluten is sourced from premium European and Canadian producers and processed to ensure high protein concentration and superior functional performance in extruded aquafeed.
product.potato-protein-meal.longDescript: Potato Protein Meal is manufactured from non-GMO European potatoes through precise extraction and drying processes that preserve amino acid integrity.

Start your Atlantic salmon lifecycle with consistency and confidence. Our eggs are sourced from certified, disease-free broodstock maintained under stringent biosecurity protocols.
product.decapsulated-dry-artemia-cysts.l: Processed under controlled conditions with 0% shell content, 0% light impurities, 0% heavy impurities and moisture controlled at 4–5%.
High protein and energy value supports rapid larval growth and strong survival performance. Reduces risks associated with bacterial contamination and unhatched cyst accumulation in larval systems.
product.artemia.longDescription.0: CPG (Number of Cyst per Gram) varies with size and genus of Artemia and is not a quality indicator on its own. Quality is defined by Hatching Rate and by the nutritional value and biomass of the resulting nauplii.
product.artemia.longDescription.1: We guarantee superior product quality and consistency with a stable hatching rate of at least 85%. Every year, about 700 tons of wet Artemia and 400 tons of dry cyst and processed Artemia are harvested from our two lakes.
product.mediterranean-sea-bass.longDescr: International standards compliant with ASC and GlobalG.A.P protocols for export excellence.
Continuous production cycles ensure 52-week availability for global wholesale, with optimized logistics for regular fresh deliveries across the EMEA and North American markets.
product.decapsulated-dry-artemia-cysts.f: Do decapsulated Artemia cysts require incubation or hatching?
No hatching is required! Decapsulated cysts have the indigestible outer shell removed and can be fed directly to larvae and post-larvae with zero shell contamination.
What is the nutritional value compared to live nauplii?
Decapsulated cysts retain 100% of their embryonic energy reserves (61% protein, 24.5% lipids, 502 kcal/100g), delivering higher caloric value than hatched nauplii.
What makes Super Fresh Chlorella V12 different from dry algae powders?

SV-12 is 100% live, fresh liquid Chlorella concentrate (14 billion cells/ml) shipped under continuous 2–6 °C cold chain. Cell walls remain intact and live, delivering maximum DHA/EPA/B12 bio-availability to rotifer and fish larval cultures.
How does SV-12 accelerate rotifer culture multiplication?
The live 2–4 µm cell size and rich lipid profile allow rotifers to achieve up to 8-fold population multiplication within 3 days without settling or fouling culture water.
product.emerald-chlorella-powder.faq.0.q: How is Emerald Chlorella Powder reconstituted in hatchery tanks?
product.emerald-chlorella-powder.faq.0.a: Mix 50–100 g per 1,000 L of hatchery water under continuous aeration. High Vitamin B12 (1000 µg/100g) and 60.6% protein content provide excellent green-water conditioning and copepod enrichment.
product.atlantic-salmon-egg.faq.0.q: How are fertilized salmon eggs delivered while preserving biosecurity?
product.atlantic-salmon-egg.faq.0.a: Salmon ova are shipped in temperature-controlled insulated containers with continuous digital temperature loggers maintaining 4–8 °C throughout air transport.
product.atlantic-salmon-egg.faq.1.q: What incubation water temperature is recommended upon arrival?
product.atlantic-salmon-egg.faq.1.a: Transfer eyed salmon eggs into incubation trays supplied with clean, well-oxygenated freshwater maintained at 4–8 °C.
product.coho-salmon-egg.faq.0.q: Are Coho salmon eggs certified disease-free?
product.coho-salmon-egg.faq.0.a: Yes, all Coho salmon eggs are SPF certified and tested free of IPNV, VHSV, and IHNV pathogens under strict biosecurity protocols.
product.vital-wheat-gluten.faq.0.q: What is the binding strength and water stability of VARS Vital Wheat Gluten?
product.vital-wheat-gluten.faq.0.a: With ≥ 150% water absorption capacity and ≥ 82% protein content, it forms a cohesive viscoelastic matrix that prevents pellet disintegration and nutrient leaching in extruded fish and shrimp diets.
product.vital-wheat-gluten.faq.1.q: Is VARS Vital Wheat Gluten suitable for marine finfish and shrimp feeds?
product.vital-wheat-gluten.faq.1.a: Yes, it is widely used as a highly digestible plant protein binder in salmonid, sea bass, sea bream, and shrimp feeds to replace expensive synthetic binders.
product.fish-meal.faq.0.q: What pelagic species are used in VARS Steam-Dried Fish Meal?
product.fish-meal.faq.0.a: Sourced from wild-caught pelagic species and trimmings under strict IFFO-RS and EU sustainability standards, delivering 55–65% crude protein and balanced essential amino acids.
product.potato-protein-meal.faq.0.q: How much fish meal can be substituted with VARS Potato Protein Meal in aquafeed?
product.potato-protein-meal.faq.0.a: Trial data shows up to 20% of marine fish meal can be replaced in sea bass and sea bream diets while maintaining equivalent feed conversion ratios (FCR) and 92% protein digestibility.
product.krill-meal-bio-additives.faq.0.q: Does Krill Meal enhance fillet pigmentation in salmon and trout?
product.krill-meal-bio-additives.faq.0.a: Yes! Rich in natural astaxanthin (≥ 150 ppm) bound to marine phospholipids, it enhances flesh color, immune resilience, and feeding response in broodstock and fry.
product.mediterranean-sea-bass.faq.0.q: What product forms are available for wholesale export of Mediterranean Sea Bass?
product.mediterranean-sea-bass.faq.0.a: We export Whole Round, Descaled & Gutted (D&G), Dressed, and Fresh/Frozen Fillets in standard sizes (300–400g, 400–600g, 600–800g, 800–1000g+).
product.mediterranean-sea-bass.faq.1.q: What cold-chain logistics options are used for EU & MENA delivery?
product.mediterranean-sea-bass.faq.1.a: Shipped in styrofoam boxes with gel packs or flake ice via temperature-controlled air freight (0–2 °C) or reefer trucks (−18 °C for frozen).
product.mediterranean-sea-bream.faq.0.q: Are VARS Mediterranean Sea Bream certified by ASC and GlobalG.A.P.?
product.mediterranean-sea-bream.faq.0.a: Yes, all sea bream are cultured in open-sea cages with pristine water exchange, certified compliant with ASC and GlobalG.A.P export standards.
product.brown-meagre.faq.0.q: What is the flavor and culinary profile of VARS Brown Meagre (Sciaena umbra)?
product.brown-meagre.faq.0.a: Brown Meagre offers a mild, sweet flavor and firm white flesh with low fat and high protein content (18g/100g), ideal for whole fish grilling, salt-crust roasting, and fine dining fillets.
product.olive-flounder.faq.0.q: How is Olive Flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) packaged for air freight?
product.olive-flounder.faq.0.a: Shipped fresh on ice or live in oxygen-injected marine containers, engineered for 52-week continuous supply to high-end sushi restaurants and distributors.
product.rainbow-trout.faq.0.q: What product forms and sizes are available for Rainbow Trout export?
product.rainbow-trout.faq.0.a: Available whole round, gutted, and filleted (200–300g portion size up to 1kg+ executive cuts) for smoking, retail, and HORECA supply.
productDetail.faq.default.0.q: What is the typical minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
productDetail.faq.default.0.a: MOQs depend on the product category: 1 carton for live feed, 50,000 for salmon eggs, and 500 kg for seafood export orders.
productDetail.faq.default.1.q: How do you ensure cold-chain & biosecurity during shipment?
productDetail.faq.default.1.a: Every shipment is packed in temperature-monitored, insulated containers with data loggers to ensure zero quality degradation during transit.
productDetail.faq.default.2.q: Can I request technical datasheets and certificates of analysis (CoA)?
productDetail.faq.default.2.a: Yes! Full technical specification sheets, laboratory analysis reports, and origin certificates are provided upon quote request.

solutions.modes.heading: Four ways we work with hatcheries
solutions.modes.description: Most clients arrive at one of these four points. Pick the one that matches where you are.
solutions.mode.build.title: Build it
solutions.mode.build.navDesc: Feasibility, RAS design, equipment and commissioning — from bare site to first stocking.
solutions.mode.build.description: You have capital and a site, and need a hatchery that actually produces. We take it from feasibility study to first commercial batch.
solutions.mode.build.item1.title: Feasibility, site and water assessment
solutions.mode.build.item1.desc: Market analysis, species strategy, site viability and the water-quality work that decides whether the project is buildable before you commit capital.
solutions.mode.build.item2.title: Hatchery and RAS engineering design
solutions.mode.build.item2.desc: Production planning and bio-engineering for land-based recirculating systems — tank layout, flow, filtration and capacity sized to your target output.
solutions.mode.build.item3.title: Equipment selection and procurement
solutions.mode.build.item3.desc: Specification and sourcing through our direct manufacturer network, so you buy the right kit at the right price instead of whatever a single vendor quotes.
solutions.mode.build.item4.title: Commissioning and start-up
solutions.mode.build.item4.desc: On-site commissioning, live feed culture establishment, biosecurity protocols and the first production runs, until the facility is genuinely ready for commercial output.
solutions.mode.build.item5.title: Licensing and EU/GCC compliance
solutions.mode.build.item5.desc: TRACES registration, veterinary health certification and ASC/GlobalG.A.P groundwork prepared during the build, not retrofitted after your first export is refused.
solutions.mode.run.title: Run it
solutions.mode.run.navDesc: Managed operations: broodstock, larviculture, live feed, biosecurity, water quality and your team.
solutions.mode.run.description: Interim or ongoing management of your hatchery — the biology, the production plan and the team. This is what we do day to day, not a slide deck.
solutions.mode.run.item1.title: Broodstock and reproductive programmes
solutions.mode.run.item1.desc: Broodstock selection and conditioning, spawning management and egg production planning, built around a breeding strategy that holds egg quality season after season.
solutions.mode.run.item2.title: Larviculture and early life stages
solutions.mode.run.item2.desc: Larval rearing management targeting survival and uniformity — weaning protocols, grading and the early-stage practices that decide what reaches your grow-out.
solutions.mode.run.item3.title: Live feed production systems
solutions.mode.run.item3.desc: Rotifer (Brachionus spp.), Artemia and microalgae production plus enrichment protocols. We run cultures reaching 8-fold rotifer growth in three days and 85% Artemia hatch rates.
solutions.mode.run.item4.title: Production planning and KPIs
solutions.mode.run.item4.desc: Annual production plans, capacity management, budgeting and the KPI reporting that tells you where a cycle went wrong while you can still correct it.
solutions.mode.run.item5.title: Biosecurity and fish health
solutions.mode.run.item5.desc: Biosecurity protocols, disease prevention, health monitoring and quality assurance — designed to keep pathogens out of a sterile recirculating system rather than chase them once inside.
solutions.mode.run.item6.title: Water quality and system performance
solutions.mode.run.item6.desc: Monitoring and interpretation of the parameters that actually move survival, with environmental control and system performance held inside their operating windows.
solutions.mode.run.item7.title: Technical team leadership and training
solutions.mode.run.item7.desc: Production team supervision, structured technical training and competency development — so the operation still performs after we hand it back.
solutions.mode.run.item8.title: SAP and AquaManager configuration
solutions.mode.run.item8.desc: Configuring SAP and AquaManager for production tracking, inventory, batch traceability and reporting. Few hatchery consultancies do ERP work; we do.
solutions.mode.improve.title: Improve it
solutions.mode.improve.navDesc: Producing already but under target — audit, FCR, live feed stability and export readiness.
solutions.mode.improve.description: The facility runs, but the numbers don't. We audit what's happening biologically and operationally, then fix the constraint.
solutions.mode.improve.item1.title: Operational audit and bottleneck analysis
solutions.mode.improve.item1.desc: A structured review of production processes and workflow to find the actual constraint — which is rarely the one being blamed.
solutions.mode.improve.item2.title: FCR and growth performance
solutions.mode.improve.item2.desc: Feed conversion, ingredient digestibility and feeding-regime analysis, with the formulation changes that move cost per kilogram.
solutions.mode.improve.item3.title: Live feed stability
solutions.mode.improve.item3.desc: Diagnosing rotifer and Chlorella culture crashes, ciliate contamination and inconsistent Artemia enrichment, then rebuilding the protocol so it holds.
solutions.mode.improve.item4.title: Export readiness audit
solutions.mode.improve.item4.desc: Auditing packing, cold chain and documentation against EU and Middle East import requirements before a rejected consignment teaches you the same lesson.
solutions.mode.source.title: Source it
solutions.mode.source.navDesc: Salmonid ova, live feed, equipment and additives, with export documentation handled.
solutions.mode.source.description: Direct access to the inputs a hatchery runs on — eggs, live feed, additives and equipment — through relationships we already hold.
solutions.mode.source.item1.title: Salmonid ova and fertilized eggs
solutions.mode.source.item1.desc: Atlantic and Coho salmon and trout eggs from certified, disease-free broodstock, shipped eyed and cold-chain verified with full origin traceability.
solutions.mode.source.item2.title: Live feed and microalgae
solutions.mode.source.item2.desc: Artemia cysts, decapsulated Artemia and fresh Chlorella, supplied to hatcheries across Türkiye, South Korea and the Middle East.
solutions.mode.source.item3.title: Equipment and feed additives
solutions.mode.source.item3.desc: RAS equipment, oxygenation and filtration through our manufacturer network, plus aquafeed ingredients — fish meal, wheat gluten, potato protein.
solutions.mode.source.item4.title: Export logistics and documentation
solutions.mode.source.item4.desc: Reefer and air-freight logistics with customs brokerage, temperature-logged and documented to clear EU and GCC border inspection.
solutions.midcta.title: Not sure which of these you need?
solutions.midcta.description: Tell us the species, the capacity and what is going wrong. We will tell you whether it is a build problem, an operations problem or a supply problem.

product.olive-flounder.exportForm.0.name: Frozen fillet
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.0.summ: Skin-on fillets frozen to export grade, cut two per fish and graded by piece weight.
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.0.note: Two fillets come from one fish, so piece weight follows harvest size: our largest grade, a 2.0 – 2.5 kg live fish, yields the 500 – 600 g/pc band.
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.0.opti: Attached or trimmed, to order. Korean buyers typically ask for fins on; it is your choice.
Plain, or lightly salted on request.
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.1.name: Fresh gutted
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.1.summ: Whole gutted fish on flake ice, air-freighted for raw-market and sashimi counters.
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.1.note: 2.0 – 2.5 kg is the largest live fish we produce, which sets the top band.
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.2.name: Live
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.2.summ: Packed in oxygen-filled bags or dedicated air containers for live-tank restaurants and retail.
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.2.note: Tell us the destination airport and we will confirm whether the corridor fits the window before you commit to an order.
product.olive-flounder.exportForm.2.opti: 24 – 30 hours door-to-door under optimal conditions. Beyond 30 hours the risk rises sharply and we will not ship it.
Worked example — Korea to the Gulf
3 – 5 h packing and transfer to ICN, 9 – 10 h flight, 3 – 6 h arrival handling, customs and pickup. Roughly 18 – 24 h total, inside the safe window.
